description: We are a passionate team of young innovators with diverse skills in programming, data analysis, research, design, and problem-solving. We aim to transform NASA’s open data and space-based resources into innovative solutions for real-world challenges. Through creativity, collaboration, and technology, we strive to create meaningful impact and contribute to a smarter, more sustainable future.
summary:
FieldIQ: Smarter Farming Through Earth Data

FieldIQ is a farmer-focused smart agriculture platform designed to help farmers make informed, data-driven farming decisions. By using NASA Earth data, FieldIQ transforms environmental and agricultural information into practical insights that support better crop management and sustainable farming.

The platform provides multiple features, including crop recommendations, a crop library, field and farm management, crop rotation planning, and a Smart Farming Calendar with guidance on sowing periods, irrigation schedules, fertilizer reminders, harvesting times, and next-crop planning. It also offers information about crop diseases, pests, insects, and their potential solutions.

FieldIQ addresses the challenge of agricultural uncertainty by helping farmers understand changing environmental conditions, manage their fields efficiently, and plan farming activities more effectively. By making complex information accessible through a user-friendly platform, FieldIQ aims to reduce guesswork, improve agricultural productivity, and promote more informed and sustainable farming practices.
details:
What FieldIQ Does and How It Works

FieldIQ is a smart, farmer-focused agriculture platform that helps farmers make informed decisions throughout the farming cycle. Using NASA Earth data, it aims to turn environmental information into practical agricultural insights. Farmers can manage their farms and individual fields, explore crop information, plan crop rotations, and organize farming activities through an interactive platform.

Benefits and Intended Impact

FieldIQ helps farmers reduce uncertainty, improve farm management, and make better-informed decisions. Its features include:

  • My Farm & Field Management: Organize and manage farming activities.
  • Crop Library: Explore crop information and growing guidance.
  • Crop Rotation: Plan suitable crop sequences for better field management.
  • Smart Farming Calendar: Get guidance on sowing periods, irrigation schedules, fertilizer reminders, harvesting periods, and next-crop planning.
  • Pest & Disease Information: Explore common agricultural threats and possible solutions.

Our intended impact is to support more productive, efficient, and sustainable agriculture by making useful information accessible to farmers.

Tools and Technologies

FieldIQ was developed as a web-based application using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with backend technologies including Node.js and PostgreSQL. NASA Earth data is incorporated to support its agricultural information and decision-making approach.

Creativity and Innovation

The creativity of FieldIQ lies in bringing multiple farming needs together in one platform rather than focusing on a single agricultural problem. It combines farm management, crop planning, agricultural guidance, and environmental information into a unified experience.

Factors Considered

Our team considered farmers' practical needs, ease of use, accessibility, agricultural uncertainty, changing environmental conditions, and the importance of sustainable farming. We aimed to make complex information easier to understand and useful for everyday agricultural decisions.
